_help: One entry per card of the grip/scale sheet. name = outliner group in the .bbmodel; len = exported length in px (before the 0.79 rig scale); grip = centre of the main fist as a fraction of the length from the bottom (read off out/gripref/models_N.png); mode = 1h | 2h | bow; lh = centre of the second fist in px along the weapon (2h, negative = below the main hand); hold = gs (hands together, blade up) | pole (diagonal across the chest); dir / at = override the hold's weapon direction / main-fist position (rig px); face = -1 turns the head or edge the other way; twist = bow twist (deg); shift = [x, z] native px when the handle is off the centre line (bow riser); status = fight | exported | new. Rebuild: node gripref/render.mjs (models sheet: node gripref/models.mjs)

weightClasses._help: A weapon's class comes from its heft = volume in % of the player's body x (1 + distance of its centre of mass from the fist in blocks), measured from the model at its in-hand size (node gripref/render.mjs prints it). light: heft < light.maxHeft; medium: < medium.maxHeft; heavy: the rest. The other numbers are how the class changes the player in an animation: windup = seconds from the wind-up key to the hit (calibrated on the approved fights: swords 0.16, the hammer 0.42), recover = seconds until the wielder is back in guard, strikeFrames = frames of the swing itself (reported, not enforced), move = run speed factor, combo = most hits in a row, knockback = blocks the defender is pushed, drivenBy = which body parts lead the swing, twirl = show-off spins allowed, brace = how much of an incoming knockback the wielder takes (a heavy weapon anchors its wielder), bladeDegPerFrame = fastest the weapon may turn in a strike (30 fps). node gripref/render.mjs writes all of this to fight_w/weapon_data.json, which the fight build helpers (whit, wsprint, wknock, wtw in fight_w/parts/common_w.js) and tools/weight_qa.js read.

light.drivenBy: wrist and elbow, torso stays upright
light.carry: held up in guard, tip high

medium.drivenBy: shoulder and torso turn, short step in
medium.carry: held at chest height, tip forward

heavy.drivenBy: hips and legs, pelvis drops, the follow-through pulls the player 0.25 block
heavy.carry: resting on the shoulder or head down near the ground, drags behind in a run
